answer: To thwart Sybil attacks, agents must stake capital to audit peers across a sparse graph. Any isolated cluster forms a topological cut where bonded validators inspect execution traces. A velvet trust score penalizes coordinated clustering, ensuring an adversary’s voyage to subvert network consensus rapidly becomes mathematically unprofitable.
